verdict_detail: All 7 required outputs created. All workflow/docs paths are root-relative (no tools/geoai-task-mcp/ prefix). CI and release are fail-closed: no || true, no continue-on-error, no if-no-files-found: ignore. CI runs npm test and npm run package canonical scripts. VSIX uploaded from vscode-extension/dist/aiworkhub-*.vsix. GitHub Release attachment is mandatory. Optional Marketplace/Open VSX publish jobs remain secret-gated but fail hard when configured. PUBLISHING.md standalone paths fixed. No runtime source, tests, extension implementation, Git history, commit, push or release was changed.

areas_covered: CI for Python package and VS Code extension — root-relative paths
Tag-driven VSIX release to GitHub Release — fail-closed
Secret-gated Marketplace and Open VSX publication — fail hard when enabled
Contributor, security and publishing documentation — root-relative paths
Local VSIX installation and Remote-SSH workspace installation
AIWorkHub/AWH identity only — no legacy product names

acceptance_checks.description: CI runs canonical Python test suite and VS Code extension static/package tests, uploads VSIX artifact, uses pinned major action versions with least-privilege permissions
acceptance_checks.evidence: ci.yml runs Python 3.10-3.12 matrix via actions/setup-python@v5 (pip install -e .), npm test and npm run package via actions/setup-node@v4, uploads vscode-extension/dist/aiworkhub-*.vsix via actions/upload-artifact@v4. Permissions: contents:read, actions:read, checks:write. Pinned major versions. No || true, no continue-on-error, no if-no-files-found: ignore. All failure paths hard-fail.

acceptance_checks.description: Tag-driven release workflow packages VSIX and attaches it to a GitHub Release; Marketplace/Open VSX conditional on explicit repository secrets
acceptance_checks.evidence: release.yml triggered on v* tags. Build step runs npm install then npm run package. github-release job uses softprops/action-gh-release@v2 with mandatory files attachment (no continue-on-error). publish-open-vsx and publish-marketplace jobs gated on secrets.OVSX_TOKEN and secrets.MARKETPLACE_TOKEN; when enabled they fail hard (no continue-on-error). GitHub Release succeeds regardless of publish jobs.

acceptance_checks.description: Workflows contain no fixed host path, LAN address, local port, owner credential, legacy product name or consumer-project path
acceptance_checks.evidence: All path references are root-relative (pyproject.toml, tests/, vscode-extension/). No tools/geoai-task-mcp/ prefix, no 127.0.0.1, no port numbers, no /home/ paths, no LAN addresses, no shrec/shrek/GeoAI consumer paths, no legacy product references. AIWorkHub/AWH identity only.

acceptance_checks.description: Contributor, security and publishing docs are concise, canonical, MIT-compatible and explain local VSIX installation plus Remote-SSH workspace installation
acceptance_checks.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md covers setup (root-relative paths), tests, PR workflow, CoC reference, MIT license. SECURITY.md covers supported versions, reporting, scope, disclosure. CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is adapted from Contributor Covenant v2.1 (MIT-compatible). PUBLISHING.md covers tag-driven release, local VSIX install (npm install, npm run package), Remote-SSH install, PyPI publish (no tools/ prefix).

acceptance_checks.description: No runtime source, tests, extension implementation/package metadata, Git history, repository name, commit, push or release is changed by the worker
acceptance_checks.evidence: Only allowed_writes paths touched: .github/workflows/*, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, docs/PUBLISHING.md, eval file. No changes to src/, tests/, vscode-extension/package.json, vscode-extension/README.md, pyproject.toml, or any runtime source or test file.

validation_commands_run: git diff --check -- tools/geoai-task-mcp/.github tools/geoai-task-mcp/CONTRIBUTING.md tools/geoai-task-mcp/SECURITY.md tools/geoai-task-mcp/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md tools/geoai-task-mcp/docs/PUBLISHING.md
